title: Production services run a single replica
impact: No HA; every node drain is a full outage
recommendation: Set min_running_instances to 2 (3 on the revenue path)

title: Credentials appear in runtime logs
impact: Credential disclosed to everyone with log access; must be rotated
recommendation: Remove the log statement and rotate the affected credential

title: Restore has never been timed
evidence: team could not confirm a restore test
impact: Backups are a hypothesis until restored
recommendation: Run a timed restore drill against a clone
